verdict.rationale: Netlify is a cloud hosting and deployment platform, so a visual infrastructure canvas is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows nothing like one. Drag-and-drop folder deploys, dashboard AI prompts and a third-party React CMS visual editor are adjacent features, not a canvas for visualizing and editing the infrastructure stack.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can visualize and edit my entire infrastructure stack on a visual canvas without writing config files
